name: Gene Swap Randomization (GSR)
model_likelihood: Conditional gene-pathway incidence randomization preserving row and column sums
inference_algorithm: Monte Carlo switching of nonduplicate gene-pathway assignments; Gobbi et al. empirical swap-count lower bound
estimand: Pathway-specific empirical enrichment p-values and standardized effect sizes
data_input: GWAS summary statistics and pre-defined pathways
tunable_settings: Number N of randomized pathway databases; number of switching steps
